entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Homeplane of Jace Beleren, a rainy plane covered in inhabited mage-rings.

entities.name: Core States
entities.description: Region at the middle of Vryn's ring network.

entities.name: Ampryn League
entities.description: Mage elite who used the energy of the Core States.

entities.name: Trovian Separatists
entities.description: Faction contesting power over the Core States and the mana stream.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: Arbiter whose death intensified the fighting.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders defeated on Vryn by overloaded mage-rings.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Healer of Vryn who developed a phoenix-feather medical method.

events.summary: After Alhammarret's death, fighting in the Core States intensifies into chaos and a failed state.
events.quote: After the death of the arbiter Alhammarret , the fighting intensified and culminated in non-stop chaos.

events.summary: Vryn is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion; its denizens defeat the Phyrexians by overloading the mage-rings.
events.quote: defeated the Phyrexians by overloading the mage-rings

relations.quote: Vryn is the homeplane of the blue-aligned planeswalker Jace Beleren .
